status: draft for v0.8, 2026-10-30 — independently re-derived 2026-10-30 (see README)
what_this_proves: That an implementation refuses the same things, with the same error code. This is the set that matters most: refusal is where the safety lives, and it can be stated without reference to any URL, store, or identity system. An implementation that authorizes where this table refuses is not conformant, whatever its signatures look like.
reading_this_table: Each row is a situation, the request made in it, and the code that MUST come back. "MUST NOT be substituted" means exactly that: returning a different code for these situations — including a more generic one — is non-conformance, because the Gatekeeper's behaviour branches on the code (see protocol.md, Pre-flight Ticket Request). Rows marked v0.8 are new in this version; every v0.7 row still holds.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: The ticket request omits actionType, or names one the profile's actionTypes registry does not contain.
ticket_request_refusals.note: Checked before any bound is read.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: The request carries no mandateId, and its boundsHash names no mandate.
ticket_request_refusals.note: With a mandateId naming a known mandate, an unknown boundsHash is MALFORMED_TICKET_REQUEST instead (Ticket Issuance, stage 2).

ticket_request_refusals.situation: The mandate's expires_at has passed.
The mandate was revoked. Revocation is permanent — a revoked mandate is never renewed or un-revoked.
A value in executionContext exceeds a per_transaction bound.
ticket_request_refusals.note: MUST NOT be reported as a cumulative failure, and MUST NOT be reported under a retired generic code.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: A cumulative_sum or cumulative_count bound whose appliesTo covers this actionType would be exceeded once this execution is applied.
The mandate is in review mode and the request carries no proposalId — with or without an idempotencyKey.
ticket_request_refusals.note: The mode is checked before the key (Ticket Issuance, stage 5): a review request without a proposal is PROPOSAL_REQUIRED, never IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: The mandate is in review_above_cap mode and a value exceeds a configured cap.
ticket_request_refusals.note: MUST NOT be downgraded to BOUND_EXCEEDED: the action is not forbidden, it needs a named approver, and the response carries the approver list. Assumes the signed approvers other than the proposer can still reach above_cap_approvals; otherwise APPROVAL_IMPOSSIBLE.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: A synchronous request (no proposalId, in any mode: automatic, or review_above_cap below the caps) omits idempotencyKey.
ticket_request_refusals.note: v0.8 widens the v0.7 wording, which named automatic mode only.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: An idempotencyKey already bound to a ticket is reused with a different profileId, action, actionType or executionContext.
ticket_request_refusals.note: Reuse with an IDENTICAL payload is not an error: it MUST return the original ticket unchanged, without consuming bounds again.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: The request body carries a retired identifier: attestationHash, frame_hash or path.
The profile the mandate references cannot be resolved.

Group mode: the union of live, non-revoked mandates matching this bounds_hash, scope_hash, profile_id, intent hash and commitment_mode does not cover the required owners, each of whom holds some live mandate for the profile (v0.8: Group roles, rule 8; v0.7: the required approver set).
ticket_request_refusals.note: A required owner with no live mandate for the profile at all is OWNER_NOT_COVERED instead (owner-not-covered).

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — Group mode: a required owner holds no live mandate for the profile at all.
ticket_request_refusals.note: The fix is a grant. Where the owner holds a mandate that does not match this one's hashes and mode, the code is COVERAGE_INSUFFICIENT.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — The mandate has been revoked and has also expired.
ticket_request_refusals.note: The checks run in the listed order (Ticket Issuance); revocation, a human act, is reported before expiry.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — review_above_cap: a value exceeds both its per-transaction bound and its above_cap_caps entry.
ticket_request_refusals.note: Bounds before caps: a request above a bound is refused, never routed for approval.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — A per_transaction bound declares requiredFor for this actionType and executionContext lacks the bound's `of` field (or carries it as null, which counts as absent).
ticket_request_refusals.note: Naming the bound and stating that the value is absent. For an action type the bound does not list, absence passes this check — but is refused where a cumulative_sum bound governs the action type, and needs approval where an approval cap reads the field (decided 2026-10-30).

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — The authenticated owner holds two live mandates with the same bounds_hash and the request carries boundsHash without mandateId.
ticket_request_refusals.note: The AS never chooses a mandate itself: the two may differ in scope, mode or intent.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — A synchronous request reuses an idempotencyKey already bound to a ticket with the same profileId, action and executionContext but a different actionType.
ticket_request_refusals.note: Not a replay: actionType selects which cumulative bounds apply, so the original ticket does not answer this request.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — The request carries mandateId and that mandate's bounds_hash differs from boundsHash.
ticket_request_refusals.note: The id selects, the hash still has to agree. A request with mandateId and no boundsHash is malformed too.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — executionContext carries a key beginning with `_` (for example _source or _imagePreview).
ticket_request_refusals.note: Reserved keys are Owner-Interface metadata and never travel. An AS MAY also refuse a key no bound of the profile reads.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — The request names a proposal and its proposalContentHash differs from the fingerprint submitted with the proposal, or is absent where the proposal carried one.
ticket_request_refusals.note: The refusal MUST NOT carry content — not the proposal's, not the request's.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — The request exceeds an approval-kind cap and the signed approvers still able to decide (not departed from the group, holding a reader key), other than the proposer, number fewer than above_cap_approvals.
ticket_request_refusals.note: Not APPROVAL_REQUIRED: the proposal it would raise could never commit. A configuration that could never reach the count is refused at signing instead (ABOVE_CAP_CONFIG_INVALID). A hard-cap or per-transaction refusal is decided first.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — The request names a proposalId unknown to this authenticated request context.
v0.8 — The named proposal belongs to a different mandate.
v0.8 — The named proposal has not been decided.
v0.8 — The named proposal was rejected.
v0.8 — The named proposal's decision window closed before it was committed.
v0.8 — The named proposal is committed, and the request's action, actionType or executionContext differ from the proposal's.
v0.8 — The named proposal is executed, and the request differs from the one its ticket was issued for.
ticket_request_refusals.note: The same request gets the original ticket back with idempotent: true (stage 3).

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — The proposal is committed and the HAP-approval signature the AS must verify does not verify under the approver's DID.
v0.8 — executionContext carries amount: -100 for a field a cumulative_sum bound reads.
ticket_request_refusals.note: For every action type. A negative value would lower a running sum and return consumed authority.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — executionContext carries a string (or a negative or non-finite number) for a field some bound reads, under any action type.
ticket_request_refusals.note: A present value is a finite, non-negative number, whatever requiredFor says; this check runs before the requiredFor check. null is absent, not present.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — Group mode: two required owners hold mandates with the same hashes and mode but different above_cap_caps.
ticket_request_refusals.note: Mandates cover each other only with identical approval conditions.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — The request's mandateId names no mandate of the authenticated owner.
v0.8 — The request's profileId differs from the resolved mandate's profile_id.
v0.8 — A content binding applies to the actionType and the request carries no contentHash, or a contentBinding that differs from the profile's declaration.
v0.8 — The named proposal is committed, and the request's contentHash or contentBinding differs from the proposal's.
ticket_request_refusals.note: A ticket binds exactly the content the deciders approved.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — executionContext carries amount: null for a bound whose requiredFor lists this actionType.
ticket_request_refusals.note: null counts as absent.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — The proposal names delete_record; the decider was shown, and signed a HAP-approval for, archive_record with the same arguments; the ticket request and the ticket name delete_record.
ticket_request_refusals.note: The approval reconstructed from the ticket carries delete_record and does not verify. A Gatekeeper verifying the ticket's approval signatures refuses the same way.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — A ticket request names a live, unexpired version 0.7 mandate on a v0.8 Authority Server.
ticket_request_refusals.note: Every mandate is re-granted under v0.8; v0.7 artifacts remain verifiable as evidence.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — review_above_cap with above_cap_caps on amount_max; the request carries no amount and names no committed proposal.
ticket_request_refusals.note: An unknown amount is treated as above the cap.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — automatic; a cumulative_sum bound on amount governs this actionType (no appliesTo); the request carries no amount.
ticket_request_refusals.note: Naming the bound and stating that the value is absent. Excluding the action type through the bound's appliesTo is how a profile admits amount-less actions.

ticket_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — The named proposal was withdrawn by its proposer before a decision.

mandate_request_refusals.situation: The request's profile_hash does not match the hash of the AS's own provisioned bytes for that profile_id.
mandate_request_refusals.note: Two parties that disagree about the profile must not sign anything under it.

mandate_request_refusals.situation: The profile declares an appliesTo member that is not in its own actionTypes registry.
mandate_request_refusals.note: A bound governing an action nobody can request enforces nothing.

mandate_request_refusals.situation: A profile in the v0.7 vocabulary (no contextSchema, no decision_owner gate) declares a cumulative_count bound without appliesTo.
mandate_request_refusals.note: Absence would mean "governs every action type", so a forgotten declaration silently throttles all writes.

mandate_request_refusals.situation: A bounds field omits boundType.
The recomputed bounds hash does not equal the submitted bounds_hash.
scope_hash is absent. An empty scope still carries the hash of the empty string — absence is malformed, not "no scope".
The mandate's disclose list is not a subset of the profile's.
mandate_request_refusals.note: A mandate may narrow disclosure, never widen it.

mandate_request_refusals.situation: A bounds value contains a raw LF or CR.
Group mode: the authenticated identity is not a grantor for this profile (v0.7: not a required approver; the code is kept).
mandate_request_refusals.note: v0.8 separates grantors from above-cap approvers; granting needs the first role only.

mandate_request_refusals.situation: An applicable profile floor requires an owner signature at a minimum binding and none satisfying it is present.
mandate_request_refusals.note: MUST fail, not warn.

mandate_request_refusals.situation: A mandate_owners entry's signature fails verification, its projection names a different owner_did, its signature fields are incomplete, or its signing DID carries no key.
No protocol version is supported by both the requesting Gatekeeper and the AS.
The mandate request carries bounds_hash but no plaintext bounds. The AS cannot enforce what it does not hold.
The request carries an owner signature (a mandate_owners entry with signature fields) but no expires_at. The owner signs the expiry; the AS may not invent it.
The request carries expires_at but no owner signature. Only a co-signing owner chooses the expiry; otherwise ttl is the request field.
A co-signed request carries an expires_at later than now + the profile's maximum TTL.
The projection carries an (owner_did, nonce) pair the AS has already signed.
mandate_request_refusals.note: Defence-in-depth against third parties only — an AS-side check is not a defence against the AS.

mandate_request_refusals.situation: The profile declares appliesTo on a per_transaction or enum bound.
v0.8 — The profile declares commitment_modes: ["review"] and the request asks for automatic.
mandate_request_refusals.note: A request for review under the same profile MUST succeed. A profile without the field admits every mode.

mandate_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — The profile declares commitment_modes: ["review"] and the request asks for review_above_cap.
mandate_request_refusals.note: review_above_cap is admitted iff automatic is listed: below the caps it runs without approval.

mandate_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — The profile declares commitment_modes as an empty list, a non-list, or a list with an entry that is not a commitment mode.
mandate_request_refusals.note: The fault is the profile's, not the request's: no mandate issues under it, whatever mode is requested.

mandate_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — A bounds field declares maximum: 366 and the request carries 367.
mandate_request_refusals.note: Naming the field and the maximum. 366 MUST succeed.

mandate_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — A bounds field declares a maximum and the request carries a value that is not a number.
v0.8 — Group mode: a bound exceeds a cap the group marked hard, or a cap on a Gatekeeper-enforced (enforcedBy: "gatekeeper") or enum bound, which is always hard.
mandate_request_refusals.note: Refused at signing, never routed: a mandate above a hard cap would fail on every action.

mandate_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — Group mode: a group ceiling exists for an optional bound and the request omits the field. (An omitted required bound is MALFORMED_MANDATE whatever the group configures.)
mandate_request_refusals.note: The signed value is the ceiling; an absent value would be no ceiling at all.

mandate_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — Group mode: the group caps read_access at "none" and the request carries "unlimited", which comes earlier in the profile's values order.
mandate_request_refusals.note: Enum values are ordered most permissive first; earlier exceeds the cap.

mandate_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — The profile declares requiredFor on a cumulative_sum, cumulative_count or enum bound, or names an action type outside its registry.
mandate_request_refusals.note: requiredFor lives inside a per_transaction boundType only.

mandate_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — Outside a group: the owner requests review_above_cap with above_cap_approvers, and above_cap_approvals is absent, not an integer >= 1, or greater than the number of above_cap_approvers other than the Mandate Owner.
mandate_request_refusals.note: An owner listed as their own only approver, with a count of 1, can never commit: the proposer never counts — in a group or not (v0.7 accepted this configuration outside a group; v0.8 does not).

mandate_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — Group mode with approval-kind caps: a request carrying an owner signature asks for automatic. The AS would sign review_above_cap, but cannot alter a projection the owner already signed.
mandate_request_refusals.note: The AS refuses rather than promotes. An Owner Interface shows the owner the mode the group imposes before signing.

mandate_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — execution_context_hash is not the hash of the profile's executionContextSchema.
bounds.profile differs from profile_id.
v0.8 — Group mode: the group's approval-kind cap is 1000 with one approval required, the owner is the group's only approver, and the request carries a bound of 5000.
mandate_request_refusals.note: The approval cannot be reached for this owner, so the caps are hard for their mandate (Group roles, rule 5): a bound at or below 1000 is signed, without above-cap fields.

mandate_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — above_cap_caps names a cumulative_sum or cumulative_count field, or profile.
v0.8 — A profile's disclose_fields names a field no bound reads (a scope value such as environment).
v0.8 — A co-signed request whose projection says subjects_disclosed: false while the owner's standing disclosure choice is set.
v0.8 — Group mode: the owner requests review_above_cap, and the group has no approval-kind caps, or approvers other than this owner fewer than its count.
mandate_request_refusals.note: The AS does not sign another mode silently.

mandate_request_refusals.situation: v0.8 — above_cap_approvers names an identity-only DID (did:email) or a service account.
v0.8 — The profile declares commitment_modes: ["review_above_cap"].
mandate_request_refusals.note: The entry is ignored, so the list admits no mode.

mandate_request_refusals.situation: An enum bound's value is not in its boundType.values.
v0.8 — A profile declares content_binding version 2 with kind text.

fail_closed_situations.situation: The Authority Server is unreachable or does not answer when a ticket is requested.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: The Gatekeeper MUST block execution. It MUST NOT reuse a cached ticket, and MUST NOT offer a "warn and proceed" or degraded mode.

fail_closed_situations.situation: The Gatekeeper cannot write the ticket to its custody archive.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: The execution MUST NOT proceed (protocol.md, Gatekeeper custody).

fail_closed_situations.situation: A read is attempted with neither a local read policy nor a legacy signed read bound.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: Deny. An unset window is a denial, not "unlimited".

fail_closed_situations.situation: A tool classified as a read declares no applicable read governance.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: Deny, or carry an explicit recorded exemption.

fail_closed_situations.situation: The target container of a read cannot be determined.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: Deny.

fail_closed_situations.situation: A tool call arrives for a tool no loaded manifest describes.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: Refuse. There is no permissive default, and read-only tools are not exempt.

fail_closed_situations.situation: The signed commitment_mode requires review but the AS supplies no pending approvers.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: Fail closed — refuse to auto-execute. This is a possible mode downgrade.

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — The Gatekeeper receives a valid ticket whose idempotencyKey is absent or differs from the key it sent, or whose mandateId differs from the mandate it verified in Phase 1.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: Refuse to execute (TICKET_REQUEST_MISMATCH). Freshness is separate: a freshly issued ticket outside the 300-second window SHOULD be refused, and a replay (idempotent: true) is exempt from it (Ticket Payload Schema, rule 4).

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — A ticket request returns idempotent: true (or the review path's original after executed) and the Gatekeeper's execution record shows the action completed.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: MUST NOT execute. A replayed ticket is a recovery signal for a lost response, not an authorization to act again.

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — As above, but the record shows the action was started and no completion.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: Surface the ambiguity to the Mandate Owner. MUST NOT resolve it by guessing; there is no idempotent-action escape hatch.

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — Two triggers inside one Gatekeeper try to execute the same committed proposal.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: Serialize per proposal; exactly one downstream effect.

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — A manifest mapping produces a scope value (a recipient list, an environment) that no boundType.of names.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: The Gatekeeper MUST NOT send it, in a ticket request or a proposal. It is checked locally and dropped before any AS call.

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — An approval surface holds no key for a proposal's content.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: MUST NOT offer the decision; shows that the content is encrypted for another device.

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — A decision carries a content fingerprint that differs from the proposal's.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: The AS MUST refuse the decision (PROPOSAL_CONTENT_MISMATCH).

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — A review mandate in a group with approval-kind caps; a proposal whose values exceed a signed cap is approved by the Mandate Owner alone.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: MUST NOT commit until above_cap_approvals other signed approvers have also approved (Group roles, rule 7).

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — An execution fails after its ticket was issued and the Gatekeeper reports the failure.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: Consumption is not released. Cumulative state counts issued tickets, never outcomes.

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — A public page shows a redacted ticket that is not a signed HAP-ticket-projection.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: MUST NOT be presented as independently verified. A "valid" indicator there is the AS re-verifying itself.

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — A HAP-ticket-projection is presented to a relying party acting on it as authorization after its valid_until.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: Refuse. Where repeating the action is itself the harm, consume the projection's id atomically on first presentation. A reader using it as evidence (a public page, an auditor) does not apply valid_until.

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — A verifier evaluates a HAP-verifier-policy and one present line is unmet.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: Fail, naming the line and the code (the specific code where one exists, else POLICY_UNMET). Absent lines impose nothing.

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — A mandate is revoked by a membership change.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: Permanent like any revocation; the record names the cause.

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — A second Gatekeeper, authenticated as another request context, presents an idempotencyKey or an executed proposalId that another context obtained a ticket for.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: The AS does not serve the original: MANDATE_NOT_FOUND or PROPOSAL_NOT_FOUND, as if the record did not exist.

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — A HAP-ticket-projection verifies only under a key other than its ticket's issuer.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: Refuse (INVALID_SIGNATURE).

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — A content binding applies to the action and a field it requires is absent, or no declared field carries a value.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: The Gatekeeper refuses before any AS call (CONTENT_BINDING_INCOMPLETE).

fail_closed_situations.situation: The Gatekeeper's recomputed scope_hash differs from the mandate's.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: Refuse locally (SCOPE_HASH_MISMATCH).

fail_closed_situations.situation: The Gatekeeper's held mandate is past expires_at plus the skew tolerance.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: Refuse locally (TTL_EXPIRED).

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — An approval surface, local or remote, recomputes proposalContentHash over what it decrypted and it differs from the proposal's.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: MUST NOT offer the decision.

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — A ticket request returns idempotent: true and the Gatekeeper's record shows only requested: the original response was lost.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: MAY execute under the replayed ticket — the action cannot have started. A revocation issued after the original ticket does not reach it.

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — A replayed ticket arrives for a request or proposal the Gatekeeper has no record of.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: MUST NOT execute.

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — A ticket with a new id arrives for an idempotencyKey or proposalId the Gatekeeper's record already shows completed.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: MUST NOT execute: the record is keyed on the request as well as the ticket.

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — The ticket's signature does not verify under its issuer, or an echoed field (profileId, actionType, boundsHash, executionContext, contentHash, contentBinding, proposalId, proposalContentHash) differs from the request.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: Refuse to execute (INVALID_SIGNATURE / TICKET_REQUEST_MISMATCH).

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — A numeric manifest mapping finds null, an empty string, an array or a boolean in the argument.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: Refuse locally (MALFORMED_TICKET_REQUEST); never coerce to 0.

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — A projection served on a public page is presented to an effector as authorization.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: MUST NOT be accepted as authorization.

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — The owner enters a list-valued scope field and one element contains a comma.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: The Owner Interface refuses it (SCOPE_INVALID_VALUE); the AS never sees scope values.

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — above_cap_approvals is 2; one approver commits, another rejects.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: The proposal is rejected. A reject from any signed decider is final, whatever approvals it already has.

fail_closed_situations.situation: v0.8 — A decider sends a proposal back with a note; the agent revises the action.
fail_closed_situations.required_behaviour: The revision is a new proposal with its own id and fingerprint; no decision on the old one carries over.

proposal_refusals.situation: v0.8 — A proposal carries its content readable, or carries no content envelope or no fingerprint (every proposal carries both; an action with no arguments has the empty object as its content).
proposal_refusals.note: The only readable per-call values are action, actionType and the executionContext fields some bound reads. Emitted by the AS at proposal submission (AS · proposal).

proposal_refusals.situation: v0.8 — The caller supplies an approver list or reader set for an above-cap proposal that differs from the signed above_cap_approvers (omits one or adds anyone).
proposal_refusals.note: Deciders come from the signed mandate: exactly the signed above_cap_approvers, each in readers or, where no reader key exists, in unreadable. Neither narrowing nor widening is allowed — the Gatekeeper acts for the proposer.

proposal_refusals.situation: v0.8 — A signed approver for whom the AS serves a reader key is listed in unreadable instead of readers.
v0.8 — readers differs from the key set of encrypted_keys.
v0.8 — A decision arrives from a DID that is not a signed decider for the proposal, or from one who has left the group.
proposal_refusals.note: Refused and not counted. Emitted at decision time (AS · decision).

proposal_refusals.situation: v0.8 — A decider who already decided sends a second decision, or any decider decides on a proposal that is no longer pending.
proposal_refusals.note: A decision is not changed once made.
